q: 1. Stock if T-square makes an angle with working edge .............
explain: The stock (head) of the T-square is designed to press against the board's working edge at exactly 90°, ensuring the blade is perfectly perpendicular to that edge and thus horizontal.

q: 2. The hardness of the pencil lead increase as numeral letter H .............
explain: In pencil grading, a higher number preceding 'H' (e.g., 4H vs 2H) indicates progressively harder, lighter graphite lead, so hardness increases as the H-number increases.

q: 3. A machine which is designed to perform the function of T-square, set square, scale and protractor is .............
explain: A drafting machine is precisely the tool that combines and replaces the functions of the T-square, set squares, scale, and protractor in one adjustable device.

q: 4. The needle point of the compass should be ............. than the lead point.
explain: The compass's steel needle point should be kept slightly shorter than the pencil lead point so the pencil tip makes full contact with the paper while the needle firmly anchors the center.

q: 5. Chisel pencils are used to draw .............
explain: A pencil sharpened to a chisel edge maintains a consistent line width when guided along a straightedge, making it best suited for drawing straight lines of uniform thickness.

q: 6. The working edge of T-square is used to .............
options: as a base of set square
explain: The T-square's working (blade) edge is used both to directly draw horizontal parallel lines and to serve as a guiding base against which a set square is placed to draw vertical/inclined lines.

q: 7. Measurements from scale to the drawings are transferred with the aid of .............
explain: A divider is used to accurately transfer measured lengths directly from a scale onto the drawing sheet without marking or damaging the scale.

q: 8. Angles in multiples of 15° are constructed by the combined use of .............
explain: By combining a T-square (horizontal reference) with a 45° and 30°-60° set square in various positions, angles in multiples of 15° can be constructed without needing a protractor.

q: 9. To draw or measure angles, we use .............
explain: A protractor is the dedicated instrument specifically designed for accurately drawing and measuring angles on a drawing.

q: 10. Parallel ruling straight edge machine is used to draw .............
explain: A parallel ruling straight-edge, sliding vertically on guide wires while remaining horizontal, is designed primarily to draw horizontal parallel lines efficiently.

q: 11. French curve are used to draw .............
explain: A French curve is a template specifically shaped to guide the drawing of smooth irregular curves that are not simple circular arcs.
